# Unideals

> Unideals is a campus-only marketplace for college students in India. Students buy and sell second-hand textbooks, electronics, cycles, hostel essentials, clothing, lab equipment and event passes with other students at their own college. There is zero commission: buyers and sellers agree on a price in chat and pay each other directly at pickup on campus.

## Key facts

- Website: https://www.unideals.in (launch page and early-access waitlist)
- Marketplace web app: https://app.unideals.in
- Android app: coming soon
- Audience: college and university students in India
- Who can trade: students with a verified account; each campus is its own marketplace
- Fees: free to join and free to list; zero commission on deals. Optional paid plans (Pro, Pro Plus) add more listings and boosts
- How a deal works: find an item, chat with the seller, make an offer, the seller confirms, pick a pickup spot on campus, pay at pickup
- Safety: verified students only, automatic message screening, reporting for listings and users, Girls Corner (a private space visible only to verified female students)
- Made by: Imaginum (https://imaginumorg.vercel.app)
